local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local LP = Players.LocalPlayer
local Cam = WS.CurrentCamera

local function getGuiParent()
    local ok, cg = pcall(function() return game:GetService("CoreGui") end)
    if ok and cg then return cg end
    return LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end

-- THEME

    Bg=Color3.fromRGB(22,22,30), PanelBg=Color3.fromRGB(32,32,44),
    RowBg=Color3.fromRGB(42,42,56), RowHover=Color3.fromRGB(58,58,78),

    Green=Color3.fromRGB(90,200,120), Red=Color3.fromRGB(220,70,70),
    Yellow=Color3.fromRGB(240,200,80),

local Connections = {}
local Killed = false
local function track(c) table.insert(Connections, c); return c end
local function kill()
    if Killed then return end
    Killed = true
    for _, c in ipairs(Connections) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
    pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("SniperCombatCam") end)
    pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("SniperMisc") end)
    local p = getGuiParent()
    for _, g in ipairs(p:GetChildren()) do
        if g.Name == "SniperToolkit" or g.Name == "SniperESP"
        or g.Name == "SniperFOV" then
            g:Destroy()
        end
    end
    pcall(function()
        UIS.ModalEnabled = false
        UIS.MouseIconEnabled = true
        UIS.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
    end)
    print("[Sniper] Terminated.")
end
_G.__SniperKill = kill

-- HELPERS
local function getRoot()
    local c = LP.Character
    return c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end
local function localPos()
    local r = getRoot()
    return r and r.Position or nil
end
local function viewportCenter()
    local vp = Cam and Cam.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1920,1080)
    return Vector2.new(vp.X*0.5, vp.Y*0.5)
end

-- NPC SCANNER
local NPCContainer = nil
local function getNPCContainer()
    if NPCContainer and NPCContainer.Parent then return NPCContainer end
    local hl = WS:FindFirstChild("Highlight")
    if hl then
        local en = hl:FindFirstChild("Enemy")
        if en then
            local hh = en:FindFirstChild("HighlightHolder")
            if hh then NPCContainer = hh; return hh end
        end
    end
    return nil
end
local function resolveChar(inst)
    if not inst then return nil end
    if inst:IsA("Highlight") then
        local ad = inst.Adornee
        if not ad then return nil end
        if ad:IsA("Model") then return ad end
        if ad:IsA("BasePart") then return ad:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model") end
        return nil
    end
    if inst:IsA("Model") then
        if inst:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then return inst end
        return nil
    end
    if inst:IsA("BasePart") then
        return inst:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
    end
    return nil
end
local function scanNPCs()
    local list = {}
    local container = getNPCContainer()
    if not container then return list end
    local seen = {}
    local function tryAdd(char)
        if not char or seen[char] then return end
        seen[char] = true
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
        local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or char.PrimaryPart
        if hum and head and root then
            table.insert(list, {
                Character=char, Humanoid=hum, Head=head, Root=root,
                IsNPC=true, Label="NPC",
            })
        end
    end
    for _, d in ipairs(container:GetDescendants()) do tryAdd(resolveChar(d)) end
    for _, c in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do tryAdd(resolveChar(c)) end
    return list
end
local function scanPlayers()
    local list = {}
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= LP then
            local char = plr.Character
            if char then
                local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
                local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if hum and head and root and hum.Health > 0 then
                    table.insert(list, {
                        Character=char, Humanoid=hum, Head=head, Root=root,
                        Player=plr, IsNPC=false, Label=plr.Name, Team=plr.Team,
                    })
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return list
end
local function scanAll()
    local list = {}
    for _, t in ipairs(scanNPCs()) do table.insert(list, t) end
    for _, t in ipairs(scanPlayers()) do table.insert(list, t) end
    return list
end

-- WALL CHECK
local function hasLineOfSight(fromPos, toPos, target)
    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.IgnoreWater = true
    local ignore = {}
    if LP.Character then table.insert(ignore, LP.Character) end
    if target and target.Character then table.insert(ignore, target.Character) end
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignore
    local result = WS:Raycast(fromPos, toPos - fromPos, params)
    return result == nil
end

-- ESP
local ESPGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ESPGui.Name = "SniperESP"

local espDrawings = {}
local function createESP()
    local d = {}
    d.hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
    d.hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
    d.hl.FillTransparency = 0.55
    d.hl.OutlineTransparency = 0
    d.hl.Enabled = false
    d.hl.Parent = ESPGui

    d.box = Instance.new("Frame")
    d.box.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    d.box.BorderSizePixel = 0
    d.box.Visible = false
    d.box.Parent = ESPGui
    local st = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    st.Thickness = 1.5
    st.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
    st.Parent = d.box
    d.stroke = st

    d.name = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    d.name.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    d.name.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
    d.name.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
    d.name.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    d.name.TextSize = 13
    d.name.Visible = false
    d.name.Parent = ESPGui

    d.dist.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
    d.dist.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    d.dist.TextSize = 11
    d.dist.Visible = false
    d.dist.Parent = ESPGui

    d.hpBg = Instance.new("Frame")
    d.hpBg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30,30,30)
    d.hpBg.BorderSizePixel = 0
    d.hpBg.Visible = false
    d.hpBg.Parent = ESPGui

    d.hpFill = Instance.new("Frame")

    d.hpFill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    d.hpFill.Visible = false
    d.hpFill.Parent = ESPGui

    return d
end
local function hideESP(d)
    d.hl.Enabled = false
    d.box.Visible = false
    d.name.Visible = false
    d.dist.Visible = false
    d.hpBg.Visible = false
    d.hpFill.Visible = false
end
local function getESP(char)
    local d = espDrawings[char]
    if not d then d = createESP(); espDrawings[char] = d end
    return d
end
local function updateESP()
    if not Cam then Cam = WS.CurrentCamera end
    if not Cam then return end
    if not Config.ESP.Enabled then
        for _, d in pairs(espDrawings) do hideESP(d) end
        return
    end
    local lPos = localPos()
    if not lPos then
        for _, d in pairs(espDrawings) do hideESP(d) end
        return
    end
    local seen = {}
    for _, t in ipairs(scanAll()) do
        if (t.IsNPC and Config.ESP.NPCs)
        or (not t.IsNPC and Config.ESP.Players) then
            seen[t.Character] = true
            local d = getESP(t.Character)
            local dist = (t.Root.Position - lPos).Magnitude
            if dist <= Config.ESP.MaxDist then
                local top = t.Head.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.6, 0)
                local bot = t.Root.Position - Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
                local ts, on1 = Cam:WorldToViewportPoint(top)
                local bs, on2 = Cam:WorldToViewportPoint(bot)
                if on1 and on2 and ts.Z > 0 and bs.Z > 0 then
                    local h = math.abs(bs.Y - ts.Y)
                    local w = math.max(h * 0.55, 12)
                    local x = ts.X - w * 0.5
                    local y = ts.Y
                    local col
                    if t.IsNPC then
                        col = Config.ESP.NPCColor
                    elseif t.Player and LP.Team and t.Team
                    and t.Team == LP.Team then
                        col = Config.ESP.TeamColor
                    else
                        col = Config.ESP.EnemyColor
                    end
                    d.hl.Adornee = t.Character
                    d.hl.FillColor = col
                    d.hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
                    d.hl.Enabled = true
                    d.box.Visible = Config.ESP.Box
                    d.box.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
                    d.box.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h)
                    d.stroke.Color = col
                    d.name.Visible = Config.ESP.Name
                    d.name.Text = t.IsNPC and "NPC" or t.Label
                    d.name.TextColor3 = col
                    d.name.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(ts.X - 100, y - 18)
                    d.name.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 14)
                    d.name.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
                    d.dist.Visible = Config.ESP.Distance
                    d.dist.Text = string.format("[%dm]", math.floor(dist))
                    d.dist.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(ts.X - 100, y + h + 2)
                    d.dist.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 12)
                    d.dist.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
                    if Config.ESP.Health and t.Humanoid then
                        local hp = math.clamp(
                            t.Humanoid.Health / math.max(t.Humanoid.MaxHealth, 1),
                            0, 1)
                        d.hpBg.Visible = true
                        d.hpBg.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x - 6, y)
                        d.hpBg.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, h)
                        d.hpFill.Visible = true
                        d.hpFill.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x - 6, y + h * (1 - hp))
                        d.hpFill.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, h * hp)
                        d.hpFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(
                            math.floor(255*(1-hp)), math.floor(255*hp), 0)
                    else
                        d.hpBg.Visible = false
                        d.hpFill.Visible = false
                    end
                else hideESP(d) end
            else hideESP(d) end
        end
    end
    for char, d in pairs(espDrawings) do
        if not seen[char] or not char.Parent then
            hideESP(d)
            if not char.Parent then
                for _, part in pairs(d) do
                    if typeof(part) == "Instance" then
                        pcall(function() part:Destroy() end)
                    end
                end
                espDrawings[char] = nil
            end
        end
    end
end

-- AIMBOT
local function aimCameraAt(target, part, smoothness)
    if not target or not part then return false end
    local cam = WS.CurrentCamera
    if not cam then return false end
    local goal = CFrame.new(cam.CFrame.Position, part.Position)
    cam.CFrame = cam.CFrame:Lerp(goal, smoothness)
    return true
end

local function findBestTarget()
    if not Cam then Cam = WS.CurrentCamera end
    local center = viewportCenter()
    local best, bestD = nil, math.huge
    local lPos = localPos()
    if not lPos then return nil end
    local camPos = Cam.CFrame.Position
    for _, t in ipairs(scanAll()) do
        if t.IsNPC or not (LP.Team and t.Team and t.Team == LP.Team) then
            local part = Config.Aimbot.TargetPart == "Head" and t.Head or t.Root
            local sp, on = Cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
            if on and sp.Z > 0 then
                local d = (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - center).Magnitude
                if d <= Config.Aimbot.FOV and d < bestD then
                    -- Wall check: cast a ray from the camera to the target part
                    local pass = true
                    if Config.Aimbot.WallCheck then
                        pass = hasLineOfSight(camPos, part.Position, t)
                    end
                    if pass then
                        bestD = d; best = t
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return best
end

local function updateAimbot()
    if not Config.Aimbot.Enabled then return end
    if not UIS:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2) then return end
    if UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
    local target = findBestTarget()
    if not target then return end
    local part = Config.Aimbot.TargetPart == "Head" and target.Head or target.Root
    aimCameraAt(target, part, Config.Aimbot.Smoothness)
end

-- MISC (flight state)
local FlightBV = nil
local function flightStart()
    local char = LP.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hrp or not hum then return end
    hum.PlatformStand = true
    if not FlightBV or FlightBV.Parent ~= hrp then
        if FlightBV then FlightBV:Destroy() end
        FlightBV = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
        FlightBV.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e5, 1e5, 1e5)
        FlightBV.Velocity = Vector3.zero
        FlightBV.P = 1000
        FlightBV.Parent = hrp
    end
end
local function flightStop()
    if FlightBV then FlightBV:Destroy(); FlightBV = nil end
    local char = LP.Character
    if char then
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then hum.PlatformStand = false end
    end
end

local function updateMisc()
    local char = LP.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hum then return end

    -- WalkSpeed
    if Config.Misc.WalkSpeed.Enabled then
        hum.WalkSpeed = Config.Misc.WalkSpeed.Value
    end

    -- JumpPower
    if Config.Misc.JumpPower.Enabled then
        hum.UseJumpPower = true
        hum.JumpPower = Config.Misc.JumpPower.Value
    end

    -- NoClip
    if Config.Misc.NoClip then
        for _, p in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
            if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.CanCollide then
                p.CanCollide = false
            end
        end
    end

    -- Flight
    if Config.Misc.Flight.Enabled then
        if not FlightBV or not hrp then
            flightStart()
        end
        if FlightBV and hrp then
            local cam = WS.CurrentCamera
            if cam then
                local move = Vector3.zero
                local speed = Config.Misc.Flight.Speed
                if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then move = move + cam.CFrame.LookVector end
                if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then move = move - cam.CFrame.LookVector end
                if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then move = move - cam.CFrame.RightVector end
                if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then move = move + cam.CFrame.RightVector end
                if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then move = move + Vector3.new(0,1,0) end
                if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then move = move - Vector3.new(0,1,0) end
                if move.Magnitude > 0 then move = move.Unit * speed end
                FlightBV.Velocity = move
            end
        end
    else
        if FlightBV then flightStop() end
    end
end

local function newFrame(parent, props, cn)
    local inst = Instance.new(cn or "Frame")
    for k, v in pairs(props) do inst[k] = v end
    inst.Parent = parent
    return inst
end

            TextColor3=Theme.Text, Font=Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize=12,
            TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        }, "TextLabel")
        local bg = newFrame(f, {
            Size=UDim2.new(0,40,0,20), Position=UDim2.new(1,-50,0.5,-10),
            BackgroundColor3=Theme.RowBg, BorderSizePixel=0,
        })
        newFrame(bg, {CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,10)}, "UICorner")
        local handle = newFrame(bg, {
            Size=UDim2.new(0,16,0,16), Position=UDim2.new(0,2,0.5,-8),
            BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255), BorderSizePixel=0,
        })
        newFrame(handle, {CornerRadius=UDim.new(1,0)}, "UICorner")
        local on = props.Default or false
        local function upd(s)
            on = s
            handle.Position = UDim2.new(0, s and 22 or 2, 0.5, -8)
            bg.BackgroundColor3 = s and Theme.Accent or Theme.RowBg
            if props.OnChange then props.OnChange(s) end
        end
        bg.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                upd(not on)
            end
        end)
        upd(on)
        return f
    end

    local function createSlider(parent, props)
        local f = newFrame(parent, {
            Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,38), BackgroundColor3=Theme.RowBg,
            BorderSizePixel=0,
        })
        newFrame(f, {CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,6)}, "UICorner")
        newFrame(f, {
            Size=UDim2.new(0.4,-10,1,0), Position=UDim2.new(0,10,0,0),
            BackgroundTransparency=1, Text=props.Name,
            TextColor3=Theme.Text, Font=Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize=12,
            TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        }, "TextLabel")
        local vLbl = newFrame(f, {
            Size=UDim2.new(0.2,-10,1,0), Position=UDim2.new(0.8,0,0,0),
            BackgroundTransparency=1,
            Text=string.format("%.0f", props.Default),
            TextColor3=Theme.Accent, Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize=12,
            TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
        }, "TextLabel")
        local bg = newFrame(f, {
            Size=UDim2.new(0.35,-10,0,6), Position=UDim2.new(0.45,0,0.5,-3),
            BackgroundColor3=Theme.PanelBg, BorderSizePixel=0,
        })
        newFrame(bg, {CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,3)}, "UICorner")
        local r0 = (props.Default - props.Min) / (props.Max - props.Min)
        local fill = newFrame(bg, {
            Size=UDim2.new(r0,0,1,0), BackgroundColor3=Theme.Accent,
            BorderSizePixel=0,
        })
        newFrame(fill, {CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,3)}, "UICorner")
        local handle = newFrame(bg, {
            Size=UDim2.new(0,12,0,12), Position=UDim2.new(r0,-6,0.5,-6),
            BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255), BorderSizePixel=0,
        })
        newFrame(handle, {CornerRadius=UDim.new(1,0)}, "UICorner")
        local drag, sX, sV = false, 0, props.Default
        local curV = props.Default
        handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                drag = true; sX = input.Position.X; sV = curV
            end
        end)
        handle.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then drag = false end
        end)
        track(UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if not drag then return end
            if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
            and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
            local rng = bg.AbsoluteSize.X
            if rng <= 0 then return end
            local nv = math.clamp(
                sV + (input.Position.X - sX)/rng*(props.Max-props.Min),
                props.Min, props.Max)
            curV = nv
            local ratio = (nv - props.Min)/(props.Max - props.Min)
            fill.Size = UDim2.new(ratio,0,1,0)
            handle.Position = UDim2.new(ratio,-6,0.5,-6)
            vLbl.Text = string.format("%.0f", nv)
            if props.OnChange then props.OnChange(nv) end
        end))
        return f
    end

    local function createCycler(parent, props)
        local f = newFrame(parent, {
            Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,32), BackgroundColor3=Theme.RowBg,
            BorderSizePixel=0,

        newFrame(f, {

        local btn = newFrame(f, {

        newFrame(btn, {CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,5)}, "UICorner")
        local idx = 1
        for i, v in ipairs(props.Options) do

        end

    end

    local function createKeybind(parent, props)
        local f = newFrame(parent, {
            Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,32), BackgroundColor3=Theme.RowBg,

        })

            TextColor3=Theme.Text, Font=Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize=12,

        local btn = newFrame(f, {
            Size=UDim2.new(0.4,-10,0,22), Position=UDim2.new(0.6,0,0.5,-11),
            BackgroundColor3=Theme.AccentDim, BorderSizePixel=0,
            Text=props.Default.Name, TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255),
            Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize=12, AutoButtonColor=true,
        }, "TextButton")
        newFrame(btn, {CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,5)}, "UICorner")
        local listening = false
        btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            listening = true
            btn.Text = "press a key..."
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent
        end)
        track(UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if not listening then return end
            if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then return end
            listening = false
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.AccentDim
            if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
                btn.Text = props.Default.Name; return
            end
            props.Default = input.KeyCode
            btn.Text = input.KeyCode.Name
            if props.OnChange then props.OnChange(input.KeyCode) end
        end))
        return f
    end

    local function createCheckbox(parent, props)
        local f = newFrame(parent, {
            Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,32), BackgroundColor3=Theme.RowBg,
            BorderSizePixel=0,
        })
        newFrame(f, {CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,6)}, "UICorner")
        newFrame(f, {
            Size=UDim2.new(0.7,0,1,0), Position=UDim2.new(0,10,0,0),
            BackgroundTransparency=1, Text=props.Name,
            TextColor3=Theme.Text, Font=Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize=12,
            TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        }, "TextLabel")
        local box = newFrame(f, {
            Size=UDim2.new(0,20,0,20), Position=UDim2.new(1,-30,0.5,-10),
            BackgroundColor3=Theme.RowBg, BorderSizePixel=0,
            Text="", TextTransparency=1,
        }, "TextButton")
        newFrame(box, {CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,4)}, "UICorner")
        local stroke = newFrame(box,
            {Color=Theme.TextDim, Thickness=1.5}, "UIStroke")
        local check = newFrame(box, {
            Size=UDim2.new(1,0,1,0), BackgroundTransparency=1,
            Text="✓", TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(20,20,30),
            Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize=14, Visible=false,

        local checked = props.Default or false
        local function upd(s)

            box.BackgroundColor3 = s and Theme.Accent or Theme.RowBg
            stroke.Color = s and Theme.Accent or Theme.TextDim
            if props.OnChange then props.OnChange(s) end

        box.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() upd(not checked) end)

    createSlider(espSec, {Name="Max Distance", Min=100, Max=5000,

    -- Aimbot
    local CombatTab = createTab("Aimbot")
    local aimSec = createSection(CombatTab.Scroll, "Aimbot (hold RMB)")

    createSlider(aimSec, {Name="FOV", Min=20, Max=800, Default=250,
        OnChange=function(v) Config.Aimbot.FOV = v end})
    createSlider(aimSec, {Name="Smoothness (x100)", Min=5, Max=100, Default=25,
        OnChange=function(v) Config.Aimbot.Smoothness = v / 100 end})
    createCycler(aimSec, {Name="Target Part",
        Options={"Head","HumanoidRootPart"}, Default="Head",
        OnChange=function(v) Config.Aimbot.TargetPart = v end})
    createToggle(aimSec, {Name="Team Check", Default=true,
        OnChange=function(v) Config.Aimbot.TeamCheck = v end})
    createToggle(aimSec, {Name="Wall Check", Default=false,
        OnChange=function(v) Config.Aimbot.WallCheck = v end})
    createToggle(aimSec, {Name="Show FOV Circle", Default=true,
        OnChange=function(v) Config.Aimbot.ShowFOV = v end})

    -- Misc
    local MiscTab = createTab("Misc")
    local moveSec = createSection(MiscTab.Scroll, "Movement")
    createToggle(moveSec, {Name="Custom WalkSpeed", Default=false,
        OnChange=function(v) Config.Misc.WalkSpeed.Enabled = v end})
    createSlider(moveSec, {Name="WalkSpeed", Min=16, Max=500, Default=100,
        OnChange=function(v) Config.Misc.WalkSpeed.Value = v end})
    createToggle(moveSec, {Name="Custom JumpPower", Default=false,

    createSlider(moveSec, {Name="JumpPower", Min=50, Max=500, Default=100,

    newFrame(flySec, {

        TextYAlignment=Enum.TextYAlignment.Top,

            if Killed then return end

            UIS.MouseIconEnabled = true

        if input.KeyCode ~= Config.UI.ToggleKey then return end
        if UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end

            UIS.ModalEnabled = true
            UIS.MouseIconEnabled = true
            if UIS.MouseBehavior ~= Enum.MouseBehavior.Default then
                UIS.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
            end
        end))
    applyMouseMode()
end

scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

--==================================================
-- SETTINGS
--==================================================

local GunESP = true
local PickupGun = false
local PlayerESP = false

local GunColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
local PlayerColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255)

--==================================================
-- GUI
--==================================================

local Gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
Gui.Name = "ESP_Gui"
Gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
Gui.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local Frame = Instance.new("Frame")
Frame.Name = "Main"
Frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(230, 160)
Frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0.5, -80)
Frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 25)
Frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
Frame.Parent = Gui

local Corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
Corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
Corner.Parent = Frame

--==================================================
-- TITLE
--==================================================

local Title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
Title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
Title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Title.Text = "Hack Menu"
Title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
Title.TextSize = 18
Title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
Title.Parent = Frame

--==================================================
-- DRAGGING
--==================================================

local Dragging = false
local DragStart
local StartPosition

Title.InputBegan:Connect(function(Input)

    if Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then

        Dragging = true
        DragStart = Input.Position
        StartPosition = Frame.Position

        Input.Changed:Connect(function()

            if Input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                Dragging = false
            end

        end)

    end

end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(Input)

    if Dragging and Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then

        local Delta = Input.Position - DragStart

        Frame.Position = UDim2.new(
            StartPosition.X.Scale,
            StartPosition.X.Offset + Delta.X,
            StartPosition.Y.Scale,
            StartPosition.Y.Offset + Delta.Y
        )

    end

end)

--==================================================
-- BUTTON CREATOR
--==================================================

local function CreateButton(Text, Position)

    local Button = Instance.new("TextButton")

    Button.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 35)
    Button.Position = Position
    Button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 42)
    Button.BorderSizePixel = 0
    Button.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    Button.TextSize = 14
    Button.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    Button.Text = Text
    Button.AutoButtonColor = true
    Button.Parent = Frame

    local ButtonCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    ButtonCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    ButtonCorner.Parent = Button

    return Button

end

--==================================================
-- BUTTONS
--==================================================

local GunButton = CreateButton(
    "Gun ESP: ON",
    UDim2.fromOffset(10, 35)
)

local PickupButton = CreateButton(
    "Pickup Gun: OFF",
    UDim2.fromOffset(10, 77)
)

local PlayerButton = CreateButton(
    "Player ESP: OFF",
    UDim2.fromOffset(10, 119)
)

--==================================================
-- GUN DRAWING
--==================================================

local GunLine = Drawing.new("Line")

GunLine.Visible = false
GunLine.Color = GunColor
GunLine.Thickness = 2
GunLine.Transparency = 1

local GunText = Drawing.new("Text")

GunText.Visible = false
GunText.Text = "GunDrop"
GunText.Color = GunColor
GunText.Size = 16
GunText.Center = true
GunText.Outline = true
GunText.OutlineColor = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)

local GunHighlight
local LastGun

--==================================================
-- FIND GUN
--==================================================

local function GetGun()

    for _, Object in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do

        if Object.Name == "GunDrop" then
            return Object
        end

    end

    return nil

end

--==================================================
-- GUN HIGHLIGHT
--==================================================

local function SetupGunHighlight(Gun)

    if GunHighlight then
        GunHighlight:Destroy()
        GunHighlight = nil
    end

    if Gun then

        GunHighlight = Instance.new("Highlight")

        GunHighlight.Name = "GunDropHighlight"
        GunHighlight.Adornee = Gun

        GunHighlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 100, 255)
        GunHighlight.FillTransparency = 0.5

        GunHighlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255)
        GunHighlight.OutlineTransparency = 0

        GunHighlight.DepthMode =
            Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop

        GunHighlight.Enabled = GunESP
        GunHighlight.Parent = Gun

    end

end

--==================================================
-- PLAYER ESP
--==================================================

local PlayerHighlights = {}
local PlayerTexts = {}

local function RemovePlayerESP(Player)

    if PlayerHighlights[Player] then
        PlayerHighlights[Player]:Destroy()
        PlayerHighlights[Player] = nil
    end

    if PlayerTexts[Player] then
        PlayerTexts[Player]:Remove()
        PlayerTexts[Player] = nil
    end

end

local function AddPlayerESP(Player)

    if Player == LocalPlayer then
        return
    end

    RemovePlayerESP(Player)

    local Character = Player.Character

    if not Character then
        return
    end

    local Highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")

    Highlight.Name = "PlayerESP"
    Highlight.Adornee = Character
    Highlight.FillColor = PlayerColor
    Highlight.OutlineColor = PlayerColor
    Highlight.FillTransparency = 0.65
    Highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
    Highlight.DepthMode =
        Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop

    Highlight.Parent = Character

    PlayerHighlights[Player] = Highlight

    local Text = Drawing.new("Text")

    Text.Text = Player.DisplayName
    Text.Color = PlayerColor
    Text.Size = 16
    Text.Center = true
    Text.Outline = true
    Text.OutlineColor = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
    Text.Visible = false

    PlayerTexts[Player] = Text

end

local function RefreshPlayerESP()

    for _, Player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do

        if Player ~= LocalPlayer then

            if PlayerESP then
                AddPlayerESP(Player)
            else
                RemovePlayerESP(Player)
            end

        end

    end

end

--==================================================
-- PLAYER JOIN
--==================================================

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(Player)

    Player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()

        task.wait(0.5)

        if PlayerESP then
            AddPlayerESP(Player)
        end

    end)

end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(Player)

    RemovePlayerESP(Player)

end)

--==================================================
-- GUN ESP BUTTON
--==================================================

GunButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

    GunESP = not GunESP

    GunButton.Text =
        "Gun ESP: " .. (GunESP and "ON" or "OFF")

    if not GunESP then

        GunLine.Visible = false
        GunText.Visible = false

        if GunHighlight then
            GunHighlight.Enabled = false
        end

    else

        if GunHighlight then
            GunHighlight.Enabled = true
        end

    end

end)

--==================================================
-- PICKUP GUN BUTTON
--==================================================

PickupButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

    PickupGun = not PickupGun

    PickupButton.Text =
        "Pickup Gun: " .. (PickupGun and "ON" or "OFF")

end)

--==================================================
-- CONTINUOUS GUN BRING TO TORSO
--==================================================

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()

    if not PickupGun then
        return
    end

    local Character = LocalPlayer.Character

    if not Character then
        return
    end

    -- R15 = UpperTorso
    -- R6  = Torso
    -- Fallback = HumanoidRootPart
    local Torso =
        Character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
        or Character:FindFirstChild("Torso")
        or Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    if not Torso then
        return
    end

    local Gun = GetGun()

    if not Gun then
        return
    end

    -- Move ONLY GunDrop to the torso
    local TargetCFrame = Torso.CFrame

    if Gun:IsA("Model") then

        Gun:PivotTo(TargetCFrame)

    elseif Gun:IsA("BasePart") then

        Gun.CFrame = TargetCFrame

    end

end)

--==================================================
-- PLAYER ESP BUTTON
--==================================================

PlayerButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

    PlayerESP = not PlayerESP

    PlayerButton.Text =
        "Player ESP: " .. (PlayerESP and "ON" or "OFF")

    RefreshPlayerESP()

end)

--==================================================
-- GUN ESP UPDATE
--==================================================

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()

    local Gun = GetGun()

    -- Detect new GunDrop
    if Gun ~= LastGun then

        LastGun = Gun

        if Gun then

            SetupGunHighlight(Gun)

        elseif GunHighlight then

            GunHighlight:Destroy()
            GunHighlight = nil

        end

    end

    if not GunESP or not Gun then

        GunLine.Visible = false
        GunText.Visible = false

        if GunHighlight then
            GunHighlight.Enabled = false
        end

        return

    end

    if GunHighlight then
        GunHighlight.Enabled = true
    end

    local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

    local Position

    if Gun:IsA("BasePart") then

        Position = Gun.Position

function GetClosestTarget(...)
    local Args = {...}
    if not Args then return nil end
    --
    local Target, Closest = nil, math.huge
    for Index, Value in next, Players.GetPlayers(Players) do
        if LocalPlayer == Value then continue end
        --
        local Character = Value.Character
        if not Character then continue end
        --
        local Head = game.FindFirstChild(Character, 'Head')
        if not Head then return Target end
        --
        local Humanoid = game.FindFirstChildOfClass(Character, 'Humanoid')
        if not Humanoid or Humanoid.Health <= 0 then continue end
        --
        local Obscuring = Camera.GetPartsObscuringTarget(Camera, {Args[1], Head.Position}, {Character, LocalPlayer.Character})
        if #Obscuring > 0 then continue end
        --
        local Vector, OnScreen = Camera.WorldToViewportPoint(Camera, Head.Position)
        if not OnScreen then continue end
        --
        local Distance = (Vector2.new(Vector.X, Vector.Y) - UserInputService.GetMouseLocation(UserInputService)).Magnitude
        if Distance < Closest then Closest, Target = Distance, Head end
    end
    --
    return Target
end

-- > Connections
for Index, Value in next, getgc() do
    if typeof(Value) ~= 'function' then continue end
    --
    if debug.getinfo(Value).name == 'ProcessProjectiles' or debug.getinfo(Value).name == 'ProcessShot' then
		local Original; Original = hookfunction(Value, function(...)
            local Args = {...}
            --
            local Target = GetClosestTarget(Args[1]:GetBase().Tip.WorldPosition)
            if not Target then return Original(table.unpack(Args)) end
            --
            Args[3] = Target.Position
            return Original(table.unpack(Args))
        end)
    end
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- CHANGE THIS to your Roblox UserId
local ADMINS = {
    [123456789] = true,
}

local function isAdmin(player)
    return ADMINS[player.UserId] == true
end

local function findPlayer(name)
    name = string.lower(name or "")

    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if string.sub(string.lower(player.Name), 1, #name) == name then
            return player
        end
    end
end

local function giveMoney(player, amount)
    local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
    local money = leaderstats and leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Money")

    if money and money:IsA("IntValue") then
        money.Value = amount
    end
end

local function teleportTo(player, target)
    if player.Character and target.Character then
        local root = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local targetRoot = target.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

        if root and targetRoot then
            root.CFrame = targetRoot.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
        end
    end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    player.Chatted:Connect(function(message)
        if not isAdmin(player) then
            return
        end

        local args = string.split(message, " ")
        local command = string.lower(args[1])

        -- /tp PlayerName
        if command == "/tp" then
            local target = findPlayer(args[2])

            if target then
                teleportTo(player, target)
            end

        -- /money 999999
        elseif command == "/money" then
            local amount = tonumber(args[2])

            if amount then
                amount = math.clamp(amount, 0, 2147483647)
                giveMoney(player, amount)
            end
        end
    end)

                toastType = toastType or "info" -- "info", "success", "loading"
                
                local toast = Instance.new("Frame")
                toast.Name = "Toast"
                toast.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 50)
                toast.Position = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -20)
                toast.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
                toast.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 35)
                toast.BorderSizePixel = 0
                toast.ZIndex = 10000
                toast.Parent = self.gui
                
                local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
                corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
                corner.Parent = toast
                
                local shadow = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
                shadow.Name = "Shadow"
                shadow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                shadow.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
                shadow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 30, 1, 30)
                shadow.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)

                shadow.ImageTransparency = 0.7
                shadow.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Slice
                shadow.SliceCenter = Rect.new(10, 10, 10, 10)
                shadow.ZIndex = toast.ZIndex - 1
                shadow.Parent = toast
                
                local icon = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                icon.Name = "Icon"
                icon.Size = UDim2.new(0, 40, 1, 0)
                icon.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
                icon.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                icon.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
                icon.TextSize = 20
                icon.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                icon.ZIndex = toast.ZIndex + 1
                
                if toastType == "loading" then
                    icon.Text = "⏳"
                elseif toastType == "success" then
                    icon.Text = "✓"
                    icon.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(76, 175, 80)
                else
                    icon.Text = "ℹ️"
                    icon.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(66, 165, 245)
                end
                icon.Parent = toast
                
                local text = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                text.Name = "Text"
                text.Size = UDim2.new(1, -50, 1, 0)
                text.Position = UDim2.new(0, 40, 0, 0)
                text.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                text.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
                text.TextSize = 14
                text.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 230)
                text.Text = message
                text.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
                text.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
                text.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
                text.ZIndex = toast.ZIndex + 1
                text.Parent = toast
                
                local textService = game:GetService("TextService")
                local textBounds = textService:GetTextSize(
                    message,
                    text.TextSize,
                    text.Font,
                    Vector2.new(300, 50)
                )
                local targetWidth = math.min(math.max(textBounds.X + 60, 200), 350)
                
                local slideTween = TweenService:Create(
                    toast,
                    TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                    {
                        Size = UDim2.new(0, targetWidth, 0, 50),
                        Position = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -20)
                    }
                )
                slideTween:Play()
                
                if toastType == "loading" then
                    task.spawn(function()
                        local rotation = 0
                        while toast and toast.Parent do
                            rotation = (rotation + 10) % 360
                            local spinChars = {"⏳", "⌛"}
                            icon.Text = spinChars[(math.floor(rotation / 180) % 2) + 1]
                            task.wait(0.1)
                        end
                    end)
                end
                
                if toastType ~= "loading" then
                    task.delay(duration, function()
                        if toast and toast.Parent then

                            local fadeOut = TweenService:Create(
                                toast,
                                TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
                                {
                                    Position = UDim2.new(1, 20, 1, -20),
                                    BackgroundTransparency = 1
                                }
                            )
                            
                            TweenService:Create(icon, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
                            TweenService:Create(text, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
                            TweenService:Create(shadow, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {ImageTransparency = 1}):Play()
                            
                            fadeOut:Play()
                            fadeOut.Completed:Connect(function()
                                toast:Destroy()
                            end)
                        end
                    end)
                end
                
                return toast
            end
            
            return self.gui
        end
        end

    local UI = {}
    UI.__index = UI
    
    function UI.new(options)
        local self = setmetatable({}, UI)
        
        self.options = options or {}
        self.title = self.options.title or "Key Verification System"
        self.subtitle = self.options.subtitle or "Powered by Junkie Development"
        self.description = self.options.description or "Please complete the key verification to continue"
        
        self.lastRequestTime = 0
        self.requestCooldown = 15
        self.maxAttempts = 5
        self.currentAttempts = 0
        
        self.player = Players.LocalPlayer
        self.gui = nil
        self.hwid = game:GetService("RbxAnalyticsService"):GetClientId()
        
        self._connections = {}
        
        return self
    end
    
    UI.createUI = function(self)
        local UIFactory = loadUIFactory()
        
        if UIFactory then
            local uiBuilder = UIFactory(Colors, Players, TweenService, UserInputService, Lighting)
            if uiBuilder then
                uiBuilder(self)
            else
                error("UI builder initialization failed")
                return
            end
        else
            error("Failed to load UI factory")
            return
        end
if self.elements and self.elements.getLinkButton then
            table.insert(self._connections, self.elements.getLinkButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                self:handleGetLink()
            end))
        end
        
        if self.elements and self.elements.verifyButton then
            table.insert(self._connections, self.elements.verifyButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                self:handleVerifyKey()
            end))
        end
        
        if self.elements and self.elements.keyInput then
            table.insert(self._connections, self.elements.keyInput.FocusLost:Connect(function(enterPressed)
                if enterPressed then
                    self:handleVerifyKey()
                end
            end))
        end
        
        return self.gui
    end
    
    function UI:close()
        getgenv().UI_CLOSED = true
        for _, conn in ipairs(self._connections or {}) do
            pcall(function() conn:Disconnect() end)
        end
        self._connections = {}
        if self.gui then self.gui:Destroy() end
        return getgenv().SCRIPT_KEY
    end
    
    function UI:handleGetLink()
        local secureGetKeyLink = Junkie.get_key_link()
        if not secureGetKeyLink then
            self:updateStatus("System not initialized", Colors.error, 3)
            return
        end
        local link = secureGetKeyLink
        
        if link then
            if setclipboard then
                setclipboard(link)
                self:updateStatus("Link copied to clipboard!", Colors.success, 3)
            else
                self:updateStatus("Get link: " .. link, Colors.primary, 10)
            end
        else
            self:updateStatus("Failed to get link", Colors.error, 3)
        end
    end
    
    function UI:handleVerifyKey()
        local key = self.elements.keyInput.Text:gsub("%s+", "")
        
        if key == "" then
            self:updateStatus("Please enter a key", Colors.error, 3)
            self:shakeInput()
            return
        end
        
        if self.setButtonLoading then
            self:setButtonLoading(self.elements.verifyButton, "Verifying", true)
        end
        self:updateStatus("Verifying...", Colors.primary, 0)
        
        if self.elements.keyInput.Interactable ~= nil then
            self.elements.keyInput.Interactable = false
        end
        
        local result = Junkie.check_key(key)
        
        if result and result.valid then
            saveVerifiedKey(key)
            self:updateStatus("Key verified!", Colors.success, 0)
            if self.animateSuccess then self:animateSuccess() end
            
            task.wait(1.5)
            getgenv().SCRIPT_KEY = key
            self:close()
            return 
        else
            self:updateStatus("Invalid key", Colors.error, 3)
            if self.shakeInput then self:shakeInput() end
            
            if self.setButtonLoading then
                self:setButtonLoading(self.elements.verifyButton, "Verify Key", false)
            end
            if self.elements.keyInput.Interactable ~= nil then
                self.elements.keyInput.Interactable = true
            end
        
        end
    end

    local ui = UI.new(options)
    ui:createUI()

    if ui.setLoadingState then
        ui:setLoadingState(true, "Checking verification...")
    end

    local savedKey = loadVerifiedKey()
    local keyToCheck = savedKey
    if not keyToCheck then
        keyToCheck = getgenv().SCRIPT_KEY
    end
    
    local result = Junkie.check_key(keyToCheck)
    if result and result.valid then
        if result.message == "KEYLESS" then
            if ui.showSuccess then
                ui:showSuccess("Keyless Mode ✓")
            end
            getgenv().SCRIPT_KEY = "KEYLESS"
            if ui.close then ui:close() end
            return
        end
        
        if result.message == "KEY_VALID" then
            if not savedKey and keyToCheck then
                saveVerifiedKey(keyToCheck)
            end
            
            if ui.showSuccess then
                local successMsg = savedKey and "Saved Key Verified ✓" or "Key Verified ✓"
                ui:showSuccess(successMsg)
            end
            getgenv().SCRIPT_KEY = keyToCheck
            if ui.close then ui:close() end
            return
        end
        
        if savedKey and not result.key_valid then
            clearSavedKey()
        end
        
    end
    
    if ui.setLoadingState then
        ui:setLoadingState(false)
    end

    while not getgenv().UI_CLOSED do
        task.wait(0.1)
    end
    return getgenv().SCRIPT_KEY
